dedupe_keys.name: goat integrated transport and spatial planning

description: GOAT is Plan4Better's WebGIS application for urban, transport and spatial planning. It combines mapping, geographic data processing, routing and accessibility indicators to compare existing conditions and planning alternatives. Inputs are spatial datasets and analysis choices; outputs include maps, accessibility results and planning indicators. Geographic coverage, time periods and resolution depend on the data loaded. Source is free under GPL-3.0 and can be self-hosted using documented Docker Compose or Kubernetes configurations. The hosted service has separate trial and subscription terms. A limitation is that accessibility measures depend on network and opportunity data and are not a forecast of realised travel behaviour. GOAT can prepare transport-network and service-access scenarios for infrastructure simulations. SUMO (model-sumo) is related traffic simulation software. Only public documentation was inspected; no cloud subscription, container or planning dataset was accessed.
